steps.name: precheck-existing-1m-surface
args: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; SELECT now() AS captured_at, version() AS postgres_version, current_setting('shared_buffers') AS shared_buffers, current_setting('work_mem') AS work_mem, current_setting('maintenance_work_mem') AS maintenance_work_mem, current_setting('effective_cache_size') AS effective_cache_size; SELECT current_database() AS database_name; SELECT relname, reltuples::bigint AS estimated_rows, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(oid)) AS total_size FROM pg_class WHERE relname IN ('task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus', 'task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_queries') ORDER BY relname; SELECT i.relname AS index_name, am.amname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.oid)) AS index_size FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam WHERE t.relname = 'task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus' ORDER BY i.relname; SELECT extname, extversion FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'ecaz'; SELECT amname FROM pg_am WHERE amname IN ('ec_spire', 'ec_ivf', 'ec_hnsw', 'ec_diskann') ORDER BY amname;

steps.name: create-spire-1m-rabitq-global1152
args: SET client_min_messages TO notice; SET maintenance_work_mem = '4GB'; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS aws_spire_1m_rabitq_global1152_idx ON task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus USING ec_spire (embedding ecvector_spire_ip_ops) WITH (nlists = 128, recursive_fanout = 8, nprobe = 24, rerank_width = 25, storage_format = 'rabitq', boundary_replica_count = 0, top_graph_enabled = 1, top_graph_degree = 32, top_graph_build_list_size = 100, top_graph_search_list_size = 96); SELECT i.relname AS index_name, am.amname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.oid)) AS index_size FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam WHERE t.relname = 'task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus' AND i.relname = 'aws_spire_1m_rabitq_global1152_idx';
